items.briefing:
Two vulnerabilities are in the spotlight today. A flaw in Zimbra email software is being actively exploited, and attackers are moving fast — organisations using Zimbra should apply any available patches immediately. Separately, publicly available exploit code now targets weaknesses in Cudy routers, meaning less-skilled attackers can easily use it. Check whether your organisation uses either of these products. Google Cloud is also urging all organisations to strengthen basic cyber hygiene, especially as AI-powered attacks become more common.

A new malware threat called WordlistLoader hides inside what appear to be ordinary text files, making it harder to spot. Staff should be cautious about opening unexpected files, even if they look harmless.

**Tip:** If you receive an unexpected file — even a plain text document — don't open it unless you've confirmed it's legitimate with the sender.

featured.title: Exploited Zimbra Flaw Highlights Shrinking Window to Patch
